question: Starting from each candidate's lowest-t within-authority margin witnesses, does a bounded iterate of 'evaluate the gate chain -> margin LP at the new geometry -> move passive joints by delta*/k' reach passive-subsystem or full-support equilibrium?
hypothesis: Replaying the margin LP on the first directed shifts' saved witnesses showed the required shift contracting at candidates 1-2 (t 0.0017 -> 0.0001). If the map is contractive near a pose, bounded iteration may reach a real equilibrium; divergence or stagnation is itself the measured answer.
units: Native MuJoCo model units, exactly as the existing source study; not animal measurements
controls: the unchanged gate chain, depth grid, contact bracketing and solver settings are identical to the passive-posture and posture-shift experiments
iterate 0 is the saved witness pose itself; each later pose is fully re-derived from recorded margins by the verifier
only passive DOFs move; root, active joints, masses, tendon paths, friction, force limits and neural data are unchanged
a lineage ending with an undecided margin LP is recorded as margin_unresolved and forces the inconclusive outcome, never a physical negative
success_criterion: One iterate whose saved witness replays passive-subsystem or full-support feasibility under the original solver; still a diagnostic placement, never standing or walking.
falsification: No lineage reaching the gate within six iterations rejects only this bounded contraction attempt seeded at the two best witnesses per candidate. Beyond-authority, lost root balance, joint-limit exit and iteration-cap endings are distinct recorded statuses.

parameters.iteration: evaluate gate chain -> margin LP on the minimum-t root-feasible sample -> passive joints move by delta*/k
parameters.seeds: lowest-t within-authority margin witnesses per candidate
parameters.driver: minimum-margin root-feasible sample; ties break by shallower depth
parameters.moved_dofs: exactly-zero tendon-map rows except the six free-root DOFs
parameters.scope: Bounded iterate of margin-directed physical shifts; each move is real geometry so contact map and bias are re-derived
